title: Vitryne format v1: shared definitions
description: Units: every length in a JSON part is in millimetres, every angle in radians, everything else SI. Binary parts declare their own units (glTF: metres).

id.description: A UUID (RFC 9562), lowercase, hyphenated. Writers create version 7; readers accept any version. Unique across the whole file.

vec3.description: A 3D point or vector, mm (a direction's length doesn't matter).

name.description: A label for people. Never used as a reference.

extensions.description: Extension data, keyed by extension name (VTRY_ official, EXT_ multi-vendor, or a vendor prefix). Readers preserve extensions they don't know.

extras.description: Application-specific data with no meaning in the format. Preserved, never interpreted.

attribution.description: Who made the thing and under which licence. Kept with the data wherever it is copied.

license.description: An SPDX license expression, or LicenseRef-... for others.

libraryRef.description: Where a copied entity came from (a library file or a cloud library), so the app can offer updates. The copy is what's used.

entity.description: The entity's id in that library.
